name: Wetlands
_terrain: A 3.3.5 zone Turtle reworked: Hawk's Vigil and Dun Agrath (dwarf settlements), the Ruins of Grim Batol, the Dragonmaw Retreat entrance, reshaped ground around Grim Batol. The 3.3.5 Wetlands, its NPCs and quests stay; Turtle's changes are merged in.
_merge_region: own=changed: only the Wetlands chunks Turtle reshaped or gave one of its new subzones are taken (the rest of the Wetlands stays 3.3.5, where 3.3.5's spawns stand); the Wetlands' sea areas (The Great Sea 2365, The Forbidding Sea 2402) are not the zone's own: Turtle reshaped them for other zones. reshaped=connected with connect_depth 8: Turtle's reshaped ground up to eight chunks around the taken chunks (Turtle's Dun Morogh slopes under Dun Agrath and Hawk's Vigil: 58 chunks, after which the seams meet within 0.5 yd); Turtle's other edits of Dun Morogh, Loch Modan, Arathi and the Badlands in these tiles stay 3.3.5. Tiles 38-41 x 36-43 are built on top of the Grim Reaches tiles. drop_removed_wmos: 3.3.5's Grim Batol entrance building, which Turtle replaced with its own, is removed (it stood in Turtle's).
_area_bits: Hawk's Vigil (4018, written as 6100) and Dun Agrath (4019, written as 6101): 3.3.5 uses those two ids for Northrend areas (config area_id_remap). Ruins of Grim Batol 5550, Dragonmaw Retreat (entrance area) 5600.
_spawn_existing_in_subzones: Turtle's spawns of 3.3.5 creatures/objects (critters, guards, furniture) only inside Turtle's new subzones; elsewhere the 3.3.5 spawns stay as they are.
_taxi_nodes: Dun Agrath (Alliance), to Menethil Harbor as on Turtle; its path to Turtle's Ironforge Airfields (another Turtle zone) is left out.
_exclude_creatures: Thandol Span Attack Trigger 90974, Scarlet Recruits 50673 and both Vladeus Springrivers (50674, 50676): Turtle's level-60 chain 80703 'Thandol Span' -> 80704 (it starts outside the Wetlands with 80730) - a piece of its own. White Stallion/Palomino 51560/51561: Turtle's horse rental (rented_mount script).
_extra_quests: Links of the zone's chains filed elsewhere: 40569 Sweet Dreams are Made of This (Gakin the Darkbinder, Stormwind; Lesser Felguards in Ashenvale drop its item) before 40570; 55221 The Stockade Search (Master Mathias Shaw; the Sealed Documents Crate in the Stockade), 55222 Investigating Corinth and 55223 Uncovering Evidence (Innkeeper Helbrek, Thelsamar) between 55220 and 55224 of the Hawk's Vigil chain.
_extra_gameobject_spawns: Sealed Documents Crate in the Stormwind Stockade (55221).
_left_out: Gowlfang 91243, Bogpaw Truthsay 60972 (and Okul 62638 in Dragonmaw Retreat) have no spawn in Turtle's DB: they appear through the dungeon's boss scripts, which are not in either Turtle source tree. Their quests (40679-40681, 40683, 55035; 41752) are left out until those scripts are available.
_spawn_existing_skip: Bruuk Barleybeard and Neema: 3.3.5 NPCs Turtle moved into its new subzones; they stay where 3.3.5 has them.
_extra_spawns: Rann Blackbeard and Orion Coalborn, at Turtle's Ironforge Airfields (Dun Morogh, just south of Dun Agrath; their ground and buildings are part of the merge): turn-ins of The Pie Delivery (55208) and Tinkering Away (55212), givers of 55207 and 55213.
_extra_creature_templates: Quest credit dummies for Sleepwalking at Day (60391) and Oscilation Inhibited Disk! (91301); Hedania (60954), whom Bert Mano calls for Strange Bedfellows.
